serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Ah! Yes…
Night walk, so calm today.
Only cars that are driving at this hour are these electric, self-driving cabs. 
Not so long ago there still were these independent taxi drivers that struggled to make a living in this industry, but AI pretty much made it impossible for them to be profitable.
Many jobs that were popular not so long ago pretty much no longer exist. Maybe in some less urbanized parts of the country there are still some cashiers or street sweepers.
From time to time people from the government would reactivate these dead jobs by giving money to some weird no-name companies to lessen the unemployment. 
In exchange for financing, these so-called ‘start-ups’ would hire people to work for a minimum wage. 
There’s no need for a business plan, it’s not about making profit after all. It’s just for the unemployment statistics to go down before the elections.
One of the things I figured out while working for the labor office…
You do what you gotta do, I guess some people care about statistics.
Politics are dirty, but there is no real alternative. Never was.
Sometimes I wish some of these conspiracy theories I see on the internet were actually true. It would mean that people at the top actually have some sorts of plan and aren’t just doing things to stay relevant.
I…{{wi}} There is no point in complaining.
Thinking about these things is just making me gloomy…
